tasks.short: Sort, wash, iron and fold laundry

steps.what: Sort clothing and articles by care instructions and condition
Load washing machines and select suitable wash settings
Iron and fold dried items and separate damaged or unsuitable articles

tasks.design: Keep sorting, loading, ironing and folding with the cleaner using existing {OTHER} washing-machine controls. No digital workflow replaces these physical actions, and existing machine-cycle time is not counted as saved labour.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work involves handling varied fabrics and inspecting real items.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing equipment already automates wash cycles; no further software gain is established.
tasks.still_hard: Unreadable care labels, stains, delicate fabrics and damaged items.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize items requiring special care before damage occurs.
tasks.altitude: The cleaner keeps the same handling and care decisions.

evidence.claim: Software alone does not perform laundry sorting, loading, ironing or folding; equipment cycles already exist.

assumptions: Shares describe active focal labour, excluding unattended wash or drying cycles.
Cleaner reads labels in s1 and chooses settings in s2; no structured garment-care database or automated fabric recognition is assumed.
Dried items are supplied by the existing drying process, unchanged outside the listed task. No new tool or maintenance work is introduced.
unknowns: Which fabric types and equipment are present
research_questions: Which item types cause the most rework or need clearer care guidance?

incremental.description: No additional software or workflow maintenance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=30+25+45=100. All active physical work remains. Existing unattended equipment operation is excluded from human baseline and cannot become a new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Request repairs and await repair workers

steps.what: Identify the repair need and confirm location and access arrangements
Request repair services with the fault details and contact information
Wait for repair workers and provide the required access and fault explanation

tasks.design: Use a short native {HELPDESK} maintenance form instead of repeating fault details by telephone when the existing site process permits it. The cleaner enters verified details and submits the internal request; waiting and access duties stay unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repair details may have to be repeated across calls before a request is logged.
tasks.enabler_now: A configured request form can preserve entered fault details and a reference.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain faults, emergency escalation and physical access requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Describe the visible issue accurately and help the worker locate it.
tasks.altitude: The cleaner can submit a clear internal request, without purchasing or contractor-dispatch authority.

reach.learn: Supply location, observed symptoms and safe access details

evidence.claim: A configured internal request form can reduce repeated fault-detail entry; the saving is a proposed local hypothesis.

assumptions: In s1 the cleaner produces site, room_or_asset, observed_symptom, contact and access constraints. Capture into the form and manual clarification of missing fields remain in s2 at 11.25 baseline units.
Maintenance coordinator dispatch and repair work are unchanged outside focal labour; no contractor response or arrival-time feed is assumed.
Test an existing request form first. Sites requiring telephone emergency reporting keep that route with no claimed reduction.
S3 includes any required exclusive waiting; notifications do not remove the need for presence and no waiting saving is claimed.
unknowns: Whether the site permits internal form submission
How often faults require telephone escalation or exclusive waiting
research_questions: Does form submission reduce repeated explanations after entry and clarification effort are included?

already_counted.description: Enter, check and submit the actual fault details

incremental.description: Check location and contact defaults when assignments change
Maintain request routing and form access

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional E1: B=100; R=20+11.25+65=96.25; gross=3.75%; minus 0.5 focal upkeep gives 3.25% net. Low: telephone or current form is already simplest. High: repeated request entry falls modestly; fault inspection and required waiting are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The cleaner may submit clearer repair requests while retaining laundry handling and on-site access duties.
reach: Provide actionable fault descriptions to maintenance staff
skills_to_grow: Describe observed faults without unsupported diagnosis
Use care labels and equipment instructions
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated repair explanations while keeping physical care and site access reliable.
